children.value: Inverse problems seek to reconstruct a signal from measurements that blur, omit, or mix its values. Direct inversion can amplify noise or leave several signals indistinguishable, so reconstruction must incorporate assumptions about the unknown signal. We study how spectral and variational regularization stabilize inversion, derive error bounds for quadratic penalties, and develop methods for deconvolution, inpainting, and tomography.
